mapper.select: SELECT scope, conversation_id, title, model, turns, updated_at FROM zzl_ai_conversation WHERE scope = #{scope} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT scope, conversation_id, title, model, turns, updated_at FROM zzl_ai_conversation WHERE scope = #{scope} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zzl_ai_conversation (scope, conversation_id, title, model, turns, updated_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{conversationId}, COALESCE(#{title}, '新对话'), COALESCE(#{model}, ''), COALESCE(#{turns}, '[]'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = COALESCE(#{title}, title), model = COALESCE(#{model}, model), turns = COALESCE(#{turns}, turns), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM zzl_ai_conversation WHERE scope = #{scope} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId}
